title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Publish — payload
description: Turn on (or rotate the parameters of) hidden-vetter admission for one criterion. Every member but criterionId has a default. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

criterionId.description: The Accepts criterion this applies to. It must already ask for vetting.

livePeriods.description: Live vetter class periods, current first (e.g. ["2026-10", "2026-09"]). Defaults to the current month.

liveTokenLabels.description: Live token labels (e.g. ["token/2026-09"]). Defaults to the current month's.

dripPerTick.description: How many attestation tokens a vetter draws per tick. Defaults to three.

events.description: Events this community is running, replacing whatever was there. Absent or empty removes every event.

eventId.description: The community's name for the gathering. It is the anonymity set for every token spent under this event, so it names something people attend — never one desk or one shift.

startDate.description: First day of the event, inclusive.

endDate.description: Last day of the event, inclusive.

graceDays.description: Days after endDate the label keeps being accepted. Defaults to fourteen.

groupFloor.description: The smallest group this community will open the label for. Defaults to three.

tiers.description: The published menu of rates a vetter may pick from.

approvedBy.description: Who approved the event. Absent means nobody has, and the label is not live whatever else is true.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Publish — response payload

criterionId.description: The criterion that now accepts a hidden proof.

requirementsDigest.description: The criterion's requirementsDigest after the change. It moves, because the digest covers the published parameters — an applicant mid-application is told its requirements changed, which is the honest answer. Null only when the criterion's manifest entry carries none.
